title: External knowledge links
description: Maps a project (the first directory under tests/features) to the external knowledge repository and areas it draws on. The only committed file that names a specific external repo — and it names only a repo/URL and area folder names, never the product detail those areas contain. Populate `projects` per project, e.g. "acme": { "repo": "acme/acme-e2e-knowledge", "url": "https://github.com/acme/acme-e2e-knowledge.git", "areas": ["kpi", "profiles"], "conventions": true }.

projects.description: Keyed by project name (matches src/paths.mjs projectOf).

repo.description: owner/name for `gh repo clone` (honours host auth).

url.description: Clone URL, used as a fallback when gh is unavailable.

conventions.description: Pull all conventions/*.md (cross-cutting). Defaults to true.
